title: nan
authors: Xavier N.A.Z.; Shiguemori E.H.; Maximo M.R.O.D.A.
key_contribution: Presents OPsCV, a GNSS-denied UAV navigation framework fusing deep inertial odometry with cross-view geolocalization via an error-state Kalman filter, evaluated on real UAV flight data.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
